name: Constraint Inversion
description: Replaces the positive exact-cover formulation ("every piece is used exactly once") with a negative mutual-exclusion formulation ("no two chosen configurations share a piece"). This preserves the mathematics (choosing k items from a domain of size k without collisions implies exact coverage) but chemically alters the problem description to suggest generic clique/independent-set search instead of exact-cover (DLX) or bipartite-matching-style backtracking. Models that fail to deduce the exact-cover isomorphism will likely write a naive combination search over the t elements, which will Time Limit Exceed (TLE) due to the massive O(t^k) search space, whereas exact cover groups by coordinate to achieve O(k!).
